proposed_fixes.title: Improve Program plugin matching for Chinese app names
plan: Reproduce the supplied Baidu app/query cases and inspect Program score inputs.
Add tests for Chinese display names with Latin executable names and Pinyin/initial queries.
Adjust normalization/scoring only where tests show a false negative or incorrect ranking.

confidence.rationale: The symptom makes this a plausible investigation, but the causal mechanism has not been isolated.

verification: Issue queries return the intended Chinese-named app without regressing executable-name search.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Program scoring may favor Latin executable names over Chinese display names for Pinyin queries; the precise scoring defect remains a hypothesis.

Comment by moooyo: Hello @VictoireWood , I was trying to repro this issue and find some evidence. This ability was provided by plugin 'program'. And as its design, it will search every win32 apps and retrieve their link path, program name and exe name etc. So, I installed "百度网盘" and tried to search them in PowerToys run as query 'bd' and "baidu". It returned the same result just as your description provide. And I noticed that its target is 'C:\Users\alias\AppData\Roaming\baidu\BaiduNetdisk\BaiduNetdisk.exe' and its app name is "百度网盘". In plugin program's code, it calculate every program's score to select the best result for this query. This score depends on some factor. Such as Name "百度网盘" and locExecutableName "BaiduNetdisk.exe". ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/510ab5e6-5a35-477e-899d-138f85253a84) So, I guess the this confused results caused by these match results: bd -> BaiduNetdisk.exe baidu -> BaiduNetdisk.exe About "百度翻译". Its link target is "C:\Users\alias\AppData\Local\Programs\baidu-translate-client\百度翻译.exe". So, I guess all of the characters you listed cannot match it. Any question, please feel to ping me.
